name: follow-up
description: Follow-Up. Keeps the deal moving. Tells you who is due today after a pitch or an offer, drafts the next note (a bump, something useful, a last note), waits for your yes, logs it, and stops at the first "no", the moment a demo is booked, after 3 follow-ups or after 30 days. Logs their replies and knows when it's your turn. Use when the user says "follow up", "who do I need to follow up with", "they haven't replied", "chase", "nudge", "bump this", "they replied", "they said no", or every morning.
